title: 馬爾馬拉海底隧道~Marmaray immersed tunnel
focus: 沉管與鑽掘接合、都會鐵路及水密變形~Immersed-to-bored transitions, urban rail and watertight deformation
summary: 馬爾馬拉跨越博斯普魯斯海峽，承包商資料列沉管段1387公尺，這不是整個鐵路計畫的長度。2013年的通車背景提供都市交通與海底工程的交會案例。本課從管節浮運、基床與接頭開始，再串接鑽掘段、軌道和救援系統，強調不同結構交界的變形相容。~Marmaray crosses the Bosphorus; contractor records identify a 1387 m immersed section, distinct from the overall railway programme. Its 2013 opening links urban transport and subsea engineering. The course follows flotation, bedding and joints into bored-tunnel transitions, track and rescue systems, emphasising compatible deformation between different structural forms.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 馬爾馬拉沉管長度與整體通勤鐵路範圍必須分開，學員先辨認海峽段和兩側地下接線。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~Separate the immersed crossing from the commuter-rail programme, identifying the strait section and underground approaches on both sides. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=14.8 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=14.8 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為16.28 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=14.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=14.8 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 16.28 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以不同顏色分列沉管、鑽掘和地面段的工程數量。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Separate quantities for immersed, bored and surface sections in the scope register. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 以整線長度報沉管數量會讓造價與風險比較失真。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~Using whole-line length for immersed quantities distorts cost and risk comparisons. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：以不同顏色分列沉管、鑽掘和地面段的工程數量。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For Marmaray immersed tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Separate quantities for immersed, bored and surface sections in the scope register. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.title: 浮運重量帳與姿態穩定~Tow-out mass balance and stability
units.mechanism: 博斯普魯斯施工情境要求把浮運重量帳和海流作用分開，靜水浮力不足以描述拖航姿態。浮力由排開水體重量決定，總質量還包含設備、臨時封端及艙內液體。重量帳只能判定淨垂直力，不能證明浮運穩定；壓載液自由表面、重心位置、拖纜與波浪都會改變傾斜反應，落底接觸亦需另建模型。~Separate tow-out mass balance from current effects in the Bosphorus setting; still-water buoyancy cannot describe towing attitude alone. Buoyancy equals displaced water weight, while total mass includes equipment, temporary bulkheads and liquid contents. A mass balance determines net vertical force but does not establish towing stability. Ballast free surfaces, centre of gravity, tow lines and waves affect heel response, and initial contact with the bed needs another model.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1025 kg/m³；排水體積=11400 m³；總質量=1.13344e+07 kg。R=(ρV−m)g/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=3438.9 kN。僅把排水體積增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14901.9 kN。邊界：靜水剩餘浮力，不驗證傾斜穩性及自由液面；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1025 kg/m³; displacement=11400 m³; mass=1.13344e+07 kg. R=(ρV−m)g/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=3438.9 kN. Increasing only displacement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14901.9 kN. Boundary: Still-water buoyancy reserve, not heel stability or free-surface verification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將吃水觀測與海流、拖纜及液艙狀態同時記錄。以實際重量清冊和吃水測量互核，量測液艙水位及橫傾，檢查密度與體積是否採同一狀態。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Record draught together with current, towline and tank states. Reconcile an itemised mass register with draught measurements, tank levels and heel, checking that density and displaced volume describe the same state. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 靜水計算正確而忽略流向變化仍可造成偏航和接近誤差。漏列臨時設備或自由液面會使浮力帳看似足夠卻缺乏回正能力，偏載也可能先造成局部接觸。~Correct static buoyancy with changing currents omitted still permits yaw and approach error. Missing temporary equipment or free-surface effects can leave an apparently adequate buoyancy balance with insufficient restoring capacity and premature local contact.
units.misconception: 剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。~Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state.
units.practice: 本案「剩餘浮力」的交付需回答：將吃水觀測與海流、拖纜及液艙狀態同時記錄。質量清冊每次變更都重新確認重心和吃水，操作窗口依核准海事方案及量測決定，不由本課靜力式制定。~For Marmaray immersed tunnel, the residual buoyancy handover must address the following evidence: Record draught together with current, towline and tank states. Update centre of gravity and draught after every mass-register change; approved marine procedures and observations determine operating windows, not this static classroom equation.

units.title: 矩形沉管的框架受力~Rectangular immersed-box frame action
units.mechanism: 馬爾馬拉矩形沉管頂板的分跨由內牆決定，研究鐵路淨空與結構牆位置之間的協調。矩形沉管的頂板、側牆與中牆透過框架連續性傳遞水土壓力，不能套圓形薄環的膜應力。單向簡支條帶只能估計局部彎矩量級；施工浮運、落底、回填和使用期的邊界不同，支承沉陷、接頭剪力及裂縫寬度仍須分階段檢核。~Internal walls define roof spans in a rectangular tube; examine coordination between railway clearance and structural partition positions. A rectangular immersed tube transfers water and earth pressure through roof, walls and internal partitions acting as a frame. A circular thin-ring membrane formula is inappropriate. A simply supported strip estimates one bending scale only; flotation, placement, backfill and service change the restraints, requiring staged checks of settlement, joint shear and cracking.
units.model: 原創教學假設：單位長載重=27 kN/m；跨距=3.3 m。M=qL²/8=36.7537 kN·m。僅把跨距增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為44.472 kN·m。邊界：均載簡支單向條帶，連續框架及板效應另驗；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: line load=27 kN/m; span=3.3 m. M=qL²/8=36.7537 kN·m. Increasing only span by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 44.472 kN·m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded simply supported strip; frame continuity and plate action need separate checks. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 對照軌道限界圖和框架支承圖，檢查牆位版本。比對頂板及中牆應變，使用含支承剛度的框架模型核對彎矩分配，將落底前後量測分開。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Reconcile railway envelope and frame-support drawings, checking wall-location revisions. Compare roof and partition strain with a frame model including support stiffness, keeping measurements before and after bedding separate. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 設備或淨空調整若刪減支承，原條帶彎矩便失去邊界。忽略中牆支承或不均勻底床會錯估正負彎矩，局部裂縫可能是邊界變化而非材料強度不足。~A clearance change removing support invalidates the original strip model. Omitting partition support or uneven bedding misallocates positive and negative moments; local cracking may reflect changed restraints rather than weak material.
units.misconception: 矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。~A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula.
units.practice: 本案「頂板跨中彎矩」的交付需回答：對照軌道限界圖和框架支承圖，檢查牆位版本。把單條帶、整體框架及接頭模型分開提交，標註適用施工階段和受力方向，保留裂縫及水密試驗的獨立判定。~For Marmaray immersed tunnel, the roof-span bending handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile railway envelope and frame-support drawings, checking wall-location revisions. Submit strip, whole-frame and joint models separately, identifying stage and load direction while retaining independent cracking and watertightness assessments.

units.anchor: 差異沉陷梯度~Differential settlement gradient
units.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角~Bedding movement and joint rotation
units.mechanism: 沉管到鑽掘段的剛度轉換使馬爾馬拉教學聚焦差異沉陷，不能只以海床平均高程判定接合。沉管基床將箱體荷載傳給海床，局部沖刷、回填不均與軟弱層固結會改變接觸分布。總沉陷小不代表接頭轉角小；相鄰管節的差異位移和支承長度才控制局部變形，施工量測須保留時間與潮位基準。~The stiffness transition to bored tunnels focuses attention on differential settlement rather than mean seabed level alone. The bed transfers tube load into the seabed, and scour, uneven backfill or consolidation alter contact. Small total settlement does not imply small joint rotation; differential movement and support length control local distortion. Construction observations must preserve time and tidal datum because immediate placement and delayed consolidation describe different mechanisms.
units.model: 原創教學假設：差異沉陷=7 mm；基線長度=130 m。β=Δs/L=0.0538462 mm/m。僅把差異沉陷增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0592308 mm/m。邊界：小變形角變化指標，不是完整固結解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: differential settlement=7 mm; baseline=130 m. β=Δs/L=0.0538462 mm/m. Increasing only differential settlement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0592308 mm/m. Boundary: Small-deformation angular-distortion indicator, not a consolidation solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 在轉換兩側設成對高程與接頭位移基線。用管節水準網、海床剖面及孔壓變化交叉核對，將整體下沉與相鄰節轉角分開評估。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Establish paired elevation and joint-movement baselines across the transition. Cross-check tube levelling, seabed profiles and pore-pressure change, separating overall settlement from rotation between neighbouring elements. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 兩端剛度不同會把小沉陷差集中成局部轉角。只追蹤平均高程可能漏掉單側失去支承，接頭剪力與止水錯台會先於明顯整體下沉增加。~Different end stiffness can concentrate small settlement differences into local rotation. Mean elevation can conceal loss of support on one side, allowing joint shear and gasket offset to grow before obvious overall settlement.
units.misconception: 各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。~Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
units.practice: 本案「差異沉陷梯度」的交付需回答：在轉換兩側設成對高程與接頭位移基線。將基床施工紀錄與長期水準資料連結至管節編號，差異變形先查基準和孔壓，再由設計者判斷接觸及接頭。~For Marmaray immersed tunnel, the differential settlement gradient handover must address the following evidence: Establish paired elevation and joint-movement baselines across the transition. Link bedding records and long-term levelling to element identifiers; check datum and pore pressure before designers interpret contact and joint behaviour.

units.anchor: 止水壓縮餘量~Gasket compression reserve
units.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡~Joint compression and sealing envelope
units.mechanism: 跨海接頭要容納施工偏差和假想地震相對位移，研究張開、剪移及止水壓縮不可互相替代。止水條依受控壓縮維持連續接觸，接縫轉角、錯台、污染與材料鬆弛都會降低最不利點的接觸能力。平均壓縮量不能掩蓋局部脫離；全尺寸試驗的結果只對測試過的幾何、水壓及荷載歷程有效，幾何餘量本身並不是接觸壓力。~Crossing joints accommodate construction tolerances and hypothetical seismic relative motion; opening, shear and compression are distinct quantities. A gasket seals through controlled continuous compression; rotation, offset, contamination and relaxation reduce contact at the weakest point. Average compression cannot compensate for local separation. Full-size test results apply only to their tested geometry, head and load history, while a calculated geometric reserve is neither contact pressure nor evidence of watertightness.
units.model: 原創教學假設：初始壓縮=21 mm；張開量=3.8 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=15.2 mm。僅把張開量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14.82 mm。邊界：單向幾何餘量，不是接觸壓或水密合格證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=21 mm; opening=3.8 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=15.2 mm. Increasing only opening by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14.82 mm. Boundary: One-direction geometric reserve, not contact pressure or proof of watertightness. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 用組合位移試驗核對止水包絡而非單向壓縮。全尺寸接頭試驗分別改變張開、錯台與外水壓，記錄漏水起點與卸載後殘餘位移，對照材料批次及溫度。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check the seal envelope with combined displacement rather than compression alone. Vary opening, offset and pressure in full-size joint tests, recording leakage onset and residual movement against material batch and temperature. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只驗張開而未驗剪移可能漏掉止水翻轉或局部脫離。扭曲或沾污的止水條可形成旁通通道，即使平均縫寬合格仍可能漏水；盲目灌漿也可能只轉移出水位置。~Testing opening without shear can miss gasket roll or local separation. A twisted or contaminated gasket creates bypass leakage despite acceptable mean width; indiscriminate grouting may merely move the outlet.
units.misconception: 接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。~An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
units.practice: 本案「止水壓縮餘量」的交付需回答：用組合位移試驗核對止水包絡而非單向壓縮。保存接縫幾何與試驗壓力的配對紀錄，由設計者核定允收包絡；驗收時不能把課堂的幾何餘量當產品認證數字。~For Marmaray immersed tunnel, the gasket compression reserve handover must address the following evidence: Check the seal envelope with combined displacement rather than compression alone. Retain paired joint geometry and test pressure, with the designer approving the acceptance envelope; classroom geometric reserves are not product certification values.

units.title: 控制網與貫通誤差~Control network and breakthrough error
units.mechanism: 水下管節與兩側鑽掘孔的控制網需要共同轉換，分析不同施工隊各自閉合但接合仍偏差的情境。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。~Underwater elements and bored approaches require common transformations even when each construction team reports a closed survey network. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
units.model: 原創教學假設：控制長度=3840 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0465421 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0511963 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: control length=3840 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0465421 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0511963 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 由第三條獨立控制線核對交界方向與高程。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Use a third independent control route to check interface direction and elevation. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 共用錯誤岸基點會使三段各自看似正確卻整體偏移。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。~A wrong shore benchmark can make separately consistent sections collectively misplaced. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.
units.misconception: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。~Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
units.practice: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：由第三條獨立控制線核對交界方向與高程。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。~For Marmaray immersed tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Use a third independent control route to check interface direction and elevation. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

units.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求~Base-alignment grade and traction demand
units.mechanism: 馬爾馬拉鐵路的坡度功率教材與車站加速分開，研究水下低點兩側坡段的符號和能量方向。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。~Separate grade power from station acceleration and examine slope sign and energy direction on either side of the low point. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain. Civil geometry and power capacity must use consistent train and speed cases. Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：列車質量=1.34e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0062 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1630.03 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1793.03 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.34e+06 kg; grade=0.0062 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1630.03 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1793.03 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 按行車方向重算上坡與下坡分量並核對質量。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Recompute uphill and downhill terms by travel direction and check mass. Calculate local grades from chainage and elevation, compare with train-performance and power models, and separately check low-speed traction and downhill braking. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 忘記坡度方向會把制動需求錯記成牽引需求。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。~Ignoring slope sign misclassifies braking demand as traction demand. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences.
units.misconception: 基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。~A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
units.practice: 本案「坡度阻力功率」的交付需回答：按行車方向重算上坡與下坡分量並核對質量。軌頂高程交付前，由土建、軌道、供電和營運共同確認同版線形及列車包絡，變更坡度時同步更新性能與容量計算。~For Marmaray immersed tunnel, the grade-resistance power handover must address the following evidence: Recompute uphill and downhill terms by travel direction and check mass. Civil, track, power and operations teams approve one alignment and train envelope before handover; grade changes update both performance and capacity calculations.

units.anchor: 入口壓力擾動~Portal pressure disturbance
units.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級~Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale
units.mechanism: 沉管與鑽掘斷面改變可反射列車壓力波，馬爾馬拉教學將動壓尺度和交界波形分開。列車進洞壓縮前方空氣，波動在洞口、橫通道和斷面變化處傳播與反射。速度和阻塞比影響壓力量級，但不可壓動壓只是比較尺度，不能替代可壓縮瞬變計算；兩車交會、門位與列車外形都可能改變乘客及設備的壓力歷程。~Changes between immersed and bored sections can reflect train pressure waves; separate dynamic-pressure scaling from interface wave shape. A train entering a tunnel compresses the air ahead, producing waves reflected at portals, passages and section changes. Speed and blockage influence magnitude, but incompressible dynamic pressure is only a comparison scale, not a compressible transient solution. Train encounters, door states and vehicle shape change the pressure histories experienced by passengers and equipment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=47 m/s。q=ρv²/2=1325.4 Pa。僅把列車速度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1603.73 Pa。邊界：不可壓動壓尺度，不是可壓縮列車壓力波解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=47 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1325.4 Pa. Increasing only train speed by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1603.73 Pa. Boundary: Incompressible dynamic-pressure scale, not a compressible train pressure-wave solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較交界前後時間對齊的壓力訊號與車速。以相同列車編組、速度和門位量測多點壓力歷程，檢查峰值、上升時間及反射抵達時刻，而不只比較一個最大值。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare time-aligned pressure signals and train speed across the transition. Measure pressure histories at several points with matching train formation, speed and door states, comparing rise time and reflection arrival as well as peaks. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 將交界反射峰當作車速增加會誤判氣動因果。以單一動壓數字當允收值會漏掉壓力梯度與反射疊加，可能使門扇、密封或乘客舒適度需求被低估。~Mistaking a reflection peak for a speed increase misidentifies the aerodynamic cause. Using one dynamic-pressure value for acceptance misses gradients and superposed reflections, understating demands on doors, seals or passenger comfort.
units.misconception: 動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。~A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「入口壓力擾動」的交付需回答：比較交界前後時間對齊的壓力訊號與車速。試車報告記錄編組、速度、溫度及門位版本，土建斷面變更與設備耐壓驗證共用同一氣動模型，不能各自選有利情境。~For Marmaray immersed tunnel, the portal pressure disturbance handover must address the following evidence: Compare time-aligned pressure signals and train speed across the transition. Trial reports retain formation, speed, temperature and door revisions; civil changes and equipment-pressure checks share one aerodynamic model rather than selectively favourable cases.

units.anchor: 所需疏散時間~Required evacuation time
units.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性~Evacuation time and zone availability
units.mechanism: 都市鐵路使用者密度和下車位置改變通道壅塞，馬爾馬拉案例需分別檢查列車與車站介面。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。~Urban passenger density and detraining position change passage congestion, requiring separate train and station-interface checks. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
units.model: 原創教學假設：前置時間=94 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=544 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為589 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=94 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=544 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 589 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 把下車流率與通道行走時間分開量測。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Measure detraining flow rate separately from passage walking time. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 以空通道步速代表滿載列車撤離會漏掉排隊。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。~Using empty-passage speed for a full train omits queuing. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.
units.misconception: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。~Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
units.practice: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：把下車流率與通道行走時間分開量測。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。~For Marmaray immersed tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Measure detraining flow rate separately from passage walking time. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 跨國承包介面使馬爾馬拉資料交付需要統一里程、設備名稱與語言版本，研究維護查詢的可追溯性。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Cross-border contracting makes consistent chainage, naming and language revisions important for traceable maintenance queries. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=107 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.0467 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為83.5514 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=107 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.0467 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 83.5514 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 抽查同一設備的現場標籤、翻譯圖紙與控制顯示。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Sample consistency among field labels, translated drawings and control displays. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 翻譯名稱相似而識別碼不同會把檢修紀錄連到錯誤裝置。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~Similar translated names with different identifiers can mislink maintenance records. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查同一設備的現場標籤、翻譯圖紙與控制顯示。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Marmaray immersed tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Sample consistency among field labels, translated drawings and control displays. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「浮運重量帳與姿態穩定」，再獨立計算「控制網與貫通誤差」。原創教學假設：水密度=1025 kg/m³；排水體積=11400 m³；總質量=1.13344e+07 kg。R=(ρV−m)g/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=3438.9 kN。僅把排水體積增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14901.9 kN。邊界：靜水剩餘浮力，不驗證傾斜穩性及自由液面；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：控制長度=3840 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0465421 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0511963 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate tow-out mass balance and stability, then independently calculate control network and breakthrough error. Original teaching assumptions: water density=1025 kg/m³; displacement=11400 m³; mass=1.13344e+07 kg. R=(ρV−m)g/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=3438.9 kN. Increasing only displacement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14901.9 kN. Boundary: Still-water buoyancy reserve, not heel stability or free-surface verification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: control length=3840 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0465421 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0511963 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 2013 年公開記錄：馬爾馬拉跨海鐵路隧道開始服務。馬爾馬拉跨越博斯普魯斯海峽，承包商資料列沉管段1387公尺，這不是整個鐵路計畫的長度。2013年的通車背景提供都市交通與海底工程的交會案例。本課從管節浮運、基床與接頭開始，再串接鑽掘段、軌道和救援系統，強調不同結構交界的變形相容。本課把「沉管與鑽掘接合、都會鐵路及水密變形」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 2013: Marmaray cross-strait railway tunnel enters service. Marmaray crosses the Bosphorus; contractor records identify a 1387 m immersed section, distinct from the overall railway programme. Its 2013 opening links urban transport and subsea engineering. The course follows flotation, bedding and joints into bored-tunnel transitions, track and rescue systems, emphasising compatible deformation between different structural forms. The course treats immersed-to-bored transitions, urban rail and watertight deformation as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 1387 m immersed section，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 1387 m immersed section; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2013 年事件：馬爾馬拉跨海鐵路隧道開始服務。~2013 event: Marmaray cross-strait railway tunnel enters service.

教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=14.8 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=14.8 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=14.8 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 14.8 min; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「剩餘浮力」：水密度=1025 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=3438.9 kN；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching residual buoyancy: water density=1025 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 3438.9 kN; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「止水壓縮餘量」：初始壓縮=21 mm，其餘輸入依單元，結果=15.2 mm；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching gasket compression reserve: initial compression=21 mm, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 15.2 mm; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「方向角誤差」：控制長度=3840 m，其餘輸入依單元，結果=0.0465421 m；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching orientation error: control length=3840 m, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 0.0465421 m; not measured or accepted project data.
